items.title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
items.summary: The article explores pruning vision‑language‑action models for autonomous driving, aiming to keep scene understanding and trajectory prediction while reducing memory and compute.
items.whyItMatters: Tech‑savvy readers care because lighter models enable faster, cheaper deployment in real‑time driving systems.

items.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.summary: The paper explores using pretrained vision‑language models to generate images by tapping into their internal representations, addressing integration challenges.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers see potential for more efficient multimodal AI, reducing training data needs.

items.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
items.summary: The paper proposes a paired weight-space programming method to reduce the modality gap in CLIP-style dual encoders, improving image-text retrieval performance.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it enhances multimodal search accuracy without sacrificing existing model checkpoints.

items.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
items.summary: The article examines how language models use injected uncertainty tokens to guide self-monitoring and error correction, revealing limitations in real-time confidence assessment.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding these limits helps improve AI reliability and debugging in complex reasoning tasks.

items.title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.summary: BiPert introduces a unified model to predict gene perturbation effects across diverse cell types using single-cell data.
items.whyItMatters: It enables researchers to infer CRISPR outcomes in new cellular contexts, accelerating functional genomics studies.

items.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.summary: The paper proposes a method to distill large datasets into small synthetic sets for self‑supervised learning by maximizing mutual information.
items.whyItMatters: Tech‑savvy readers care because it could reduce storage and training costs while preserving SSL performance.

items.title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
items.summary: The article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework to translate high-level network intents into concrete optimization and control actions in autonomous communication networks.
items.whyItMatters: It enables smarter, self‑directed network management, improving efficiency and responsiveness for future mobile infrastructures.

items.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
items.summary: CTLink segments chest CT findings described in radiology reports using a text‑prompted 3D model trained on thousands of scans.
items.whyItMatters: It links report language to scan visuals, improving diagnostic clarity and workflow efficiency for clinicians.

items.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
items.summary: The article shows SIGReg’s isotropic Gaussian regularizer fails, proposes a better version that improves ImageNet-100 accuracy faster.
items.whyItMatters: Better regularization can boost model efficiency and performance, key for deploying faster, more accurate vision systems.

items.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
items.summary: ActSpace-Bench tests whether vision‑language models can actively explore environments to answer spatial questions.
items.whyItMatters: It evaluates VLMs’ real‑world navigation and reasoning abilities, crucial for robotics and autonomous agents.

items.title: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
items.summary: A physics-guided DDPM predicts 30 m water‑depth fields for the Des Plaines River over four days, reducing computational cost versus full 2‑D SWE solvers.
items.whyItMatters: It offers faster, high‑resolution flood forecasts, useful for real‑time emergency planning and resource allocation.

items.title: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
items.summary: The article discusses ensuring correctness of PDE solver outputs by having solvers provide certificates, covering traditional finite element methods, LLM-generated programs, and neural surrogates.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because reliable simulation results are critical for safety, regulatory compliance, and trustworthy AI-driven modeling.

items.title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
items.summary: We study how to represent and randomize points in d-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. Given n private and n public points, we analyze local mechanisms that randomize each private point or its distances to the public points. items.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.summary: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. items.title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
items.summary: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code…

items.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
items.summary: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration…

items.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL…

items.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
items.summary: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over…

items.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
items.summary: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models, we find that order-sensitivity is pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation and unreliable decision-making. These effects become more…

items.title: EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models
items.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring.
